title: First Alert Forecast: Flash Flood Warning for northern half of Kauai
summary: At 8pm, Tropical Storm Nolo was 455 miles WNW of Lihue with winds of 65 mph. It was moving WNW at 6 mph. Nolo is forecast to regain hurricane strength over the weekend, but will be far enough away that its influence on our weather will finally end.
author: Dan Cooke
title_norm: first alert forecast flash flood warning for northern half of kauai
